metadata.description: uehaj's Claude Code plugins: skills under /uehaj:<skill>, plus function-hook experiments.

plugins.name: uehaj
plugins.description: Skills by uehaj: sys1grep (grep by meaning via @uehaj/sys1grep, model-invoked, with --summarize), /uehaj:semgrep (the older @uehaj/semgrep), and run-interactive (run an interactive command in a herdr side pane under script, let the human answer, collect the log), gh-issue-map (a table and a dependency graph of a GitHub repository's issues, PRs and commits, in one HTML page), /uehaj:coordinator (one session hands issues and PRs to a few worker sessions over cross-session messages, answers their questions, and manages review and merge), and hatena-x-comment-refine (rewrites Hatena Bookmark comments on x.com bookmarks as "[tag][tag] summary" after reading each post, through Claude in Chrome)

plugins.name: playground
plugins.description: Function-hook experiments that draw in a pane: /img shows a PNG, /mandel draws the Mandelbrot set. Needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1.

plugins.name: decision-pane
plugins.description: A pane of the decisions in decisions.md waiting on you. OK settles an item, Hold folds it away, a comment keeps it open for the AI to answer and refine; held and settled items fold into their own sections. Icons and colors show whose turn it is. Needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1.
